title: Page 208
transc:
No 2
RR McCaine  Wash'n Oct 22nd 64 
Hang Noah Nelson Brooks Fanny for Pearl J. W. For =
Syth Chief of Satan yacht Pay mast hers will leave
here Woodbury morning Nelson Baker inst with funds for pay
ment Talbot Morgan Peru Pelton and others yardstick Please have
sufficient east court at Florida for their protection yawl B
W Brin Acting Pray mestn Spark many men many minds


( No 1 )  1230 Pm
Horner N. Y.  Wash Oct. 22 1864
Grapes Viola for paradise Brown & tappan Van Vliet
Vincent Quadroon ---- The orders in relation to Shipment
of supplies suspended by my telegraphic dispatch of Gassette
inst. from blubber are renewed ---- Let the supplies
as shipped be sent to Hil - ton Head to be
stored there if there is storage or until the
store houses are filled pedlar The remainder tobe held 
afloat for instant transfer to some vernon when needed 
---- I will add tooth list by mail bender


Beckwith  Wash'n Oct 22nd 1864
Rosalie Oliver Arnold Belly Tulip Spencer received this evening
induces me to delay sending the despatches mentioned in
my whim last night yacht They will be transmitted
with other Watsons by special messenger Wedlock yawl Comb
